title: Stokke Recalls Trailz Strollers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stroller handle can break while in use, posing a fall hazard to the infant. Units: About 400.

title: Civia Cycles Recalls Hyland Bicycles, Aluminum Civia Fenders Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The fender mounting bracket can break or bend, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,000.

title: Gena Accessories Recalls Women’s Scarves Due to Burn Hazard, Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel and pose a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,400.

title: Goochie Goo Garbs Recalls Children's Sensory Grab Garb Blankets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Wire-edged ribbon used in the blanket's ribbon tags can become exposed, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 125.

title: Homelite Recalls Electric Blower Vacuums Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The blower vacuum can overheat, spark and catch on fire posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 823,000 in the United States and 41,000 in Canada (Models UT42120 and UT42120A of this product were previously recalled in February 2013).

title: OWT Industries Recalls Electric Blower Vacuums Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The blower vacuum can overheat, spark and catch on fire posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 225,000 in the United States (Models 20254EG and 20254EGC of this product were previously recalled in February 2013).

title: Toro Recalls Recycler Mowers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Mowers were assembled with an incorrect blade driver and blade combination, which can cause the blade to break, resulting in an injury hazard. Units: About 800 in the US and 100 in Canada.

title: Cycle Gear Recalls Semi Truck and Motorcycle Toys Due to Excessive Lead Levels (Recall Alert)
summary: The toys contain excessive levels of lead, which is a violation of the federal standard for lead content. Units: About 155.

title: Husky Vertical Bike Hooks Recalled by Waterloo Industries Due to Risk of Injury; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The mounted bike hooks can unexpectedly detach, allowing the bike to fall. This poses a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: About 105,000 in the U.S. and 15,000 in Canada.

title: San Pedro Manufacturing Recalls Renovated Mattresses and Foundations Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The mattresses and foundations fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,800.

title: Yamaha Recalls Viking VI Side x Side Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear wheels can loosen and cause the rear end of the vehicle to wobble or the rear wheels to come off and cause the vehicle to crash, resulting an injury or death hazard. Units: About 3,500.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by Smooth Industries Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,600.

title: Dimension Industries Recalls Outdoor Patio Set Rockers Due to Fall Hazard: Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The patio sets' rocking chairs can break during normal use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: Branded LLC Recalls Kaleidoscope Toy Due to Choking, Laceration Hazards; Offered Exclusively at H-E-B Stores in Texas
summary: The end caps of the kaleidoscope can be removed and expose small parts that can come loose and pose a choking hazard to small children and internal components that pose a risk of laceration. Units: About 35,000.

title: Pedego Recalls Electric Bicycle Batteries Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Whistler Recalls Jump&Go Portable Jumpstart and Power Supply Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The jumpstart's lithium battery can overheat and cause the units to melt, catch fire and ignite nearby items, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,400.

title: Roberta Roller Rabbit Recalls Children’s Pajama Sets Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 32,000.

title: J. Crew Expands Recall of Baby Coveralls Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Snaps on the coveralls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000 (8,700 additional baby coveralls were recalled in May 2014).

title: Shark Vacuum Cleaners Recalled by Euro-Pro Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The aluminum wand can disconnect from the vacuum cleaner's handle and remain energized with electricity, posing a risk of electric shock. Units: About 142,000 in the United States and about 650 in Canada.

title: Gorsuch Recalls ERTLRENZ Ski Boot Heat Liners Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Liner can overheat when charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 300.

title: Hair Dryers Recalled by AG Hair Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device, which guards against electrocution or shock if the dryer is immersed in water. Units: About 3,100.

title: Lenovo Expands Recall of Battery Packs for ThinkPad Notebook Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 148,800 in the United States and 17,700 in Canada (About 34,500 in the United States and 2,900 in Canada were recalled in March 2014).

title: Trek Recalls Bicycles Equipped with Front Disc Brakes to Replace Quick Release Lever Due to Crash Hazard
summary: An open quick release lever on the bicycle's front wheel hub can come into contact with the front disc brake assembly, causing the front wheel to come to a sudden stop or separate from the bicycle, posing a risk of injury to the rider. Units: About 900,000 in the U.S. and 98,000 in Canada.
